q: 最轻量的同步工具通常是什么？
q_en: What's usually the lightest-weight synchronization tool for this?

原子变量

options_en: A condition variable.
An atomic variable.

why: 原子变量适合单变量计数、标志和简单统计，CPU 原子指令能把更新做成不可分割步骤。它不适合同时维护多个字段的业务不变量。

tradeoff: 原子变量的单变量轻量更新 vs 锁的多字段不变量保护

q: 这段结构最重要的并发保证是什么？

codeSample:
permits = threading.Semaphore(5)

permits.acquire()
try:
    do_work()
finally:
    permits.release()
options: 异常时也归还许可，避免容量永久泄漏
让所有请求永久串行执行
把 do_work 变成 CPU 原子指令
让等待线程忙等而不是睡眠
options_en: The permit is returned even on exception, so capacity is never leaked.
It makes every request run fully serially forever.
It turns do_work into a single CPU atomic instruction.
It makes waiting threads busy-wait instead of sleep.
why: 若 do_work 抛异常又没有 finally，许可永远不还，5 个名额被逐渐吃光，后续线程在 acquire 上永久阻塞。finally 强制两条路径都归还许可，代价是 do_work 仍要能安全重试。
why_en: The finally block prevents leaked semaphore permits when the protected operation fails or throws, so capacity is always returned on both the success and failure path.
whenOtherWins: 如果语言提供可靠的上下文管理或 try-with-resources，可以用它表达同样的获取和释放语义。
tradeoff: finally 中释放许可 vs 只在正常路径手动释放留下泄漏窗口

why_en: A condition-variable wait releases the lock and parks the thread, then reacquires the lock before the thread continues.

with lock:

why_en: The lock protects the read-modify-write sequence so concurrent deposits cannot overwrite each other.
